answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond in 3 layers and files a fresh spiral survey at one vertex of an open graph. An auditor replays the spiral path to the nadir vertex; a reused survey or shared vertex burns that layer and below. First filing 38, the k-th 38+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,534,500 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. A rented-layer ring fails: each layer needs a new survey. An honest agent files once for 38, keeping bond and share.
